title: Polynomial-Time Computability of a Dynamic-Programming Step
statement: For every finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the binary alphabet and all natural numbers $c$, $B$, and $e$, the function that performs one dynamic-programming step on an encoded bit string is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the binary alphabet
